title: Patio Paver Delivery

serves.summary: The learner shapes a rectangular patio from unit-square pavers so it uses an exact number of pavers, which shows that area is found by tiling and by multiplying the side lengths.

request.objective: Find the area of a rectangle by tiling it with unit squares, and relate the count to multiplying its side lengths (3.MD.C.7)

problems.ask: Shape the patio so it uses exactly 12 pavers.
problems.goal: The patio is exactly 12 pavers: across times down is 12.

problems.ask: Shape the patio so it uses exactly 18 pavers.
problems.goal: The patio is exactly 18 pavers: across times down is 18.

problems.ask: This patio has to be 2 rows deep. Make it use exactly 14 pavers.
problems.goal: With 2 rows, the patio is 7 across.

problems.ask: Shape the patio so it uses exactly 30 pavers.
problems.goal: The patio is exactly 30 pavers: 6 across and 5 down, or 5 across and 6 down.
